1.web: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
1.asv: Surely there is a mine for silver, And a place for gold which they refine.

2.web: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
2.asv: Iron is taken out of the earth, And copper is molten out of the stone.

3.web: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
3.asv: Man setteth an end to darkness, And searcheth out, to the furthest bound, The stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

4.web: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
4.asv: He breaketh open a shaft away from where men sojourn; They are forgotten of the foot; They hang afar from men, they swing to and fro.

5.web: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
5.asv: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread; And underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

6.web: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
6.asv: The stones thereof are the place of sapphires, And it hath dust of gold.

7.web: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
7.asv: That path no bird of prey knoweth, Neither hath the falcon’s eye seen it:

8.web: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
8.asv: The proud beasts have not trodden it, Nor hath the fierce lion passed thereby.

9.web: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
9.asv: He putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.

10.web: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
10.asv: He cutteth out channels among the rocks; And his eye seeth every precious thing.

11.web: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
11.asv: He bindeth the streams that they trickle not; And the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

12.web: “But where shall wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
12.asv: But where shall wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?

13.web: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.
13.asv: Man knoweth not the price thereof; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

14.web: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
14.asv: The deep saith, It is not in me; And the sea saith, It is not with me.

15.web: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for its price.
15.asv: It cannot be gotten for gold, Neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

16.web: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
16.asv: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, With the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

17.web: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
17.asv: Gold and glass cannot equal it, Neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

18.web: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
18.asv: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal: Yea, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

19.web: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
19.asv: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

20.web: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
20.asv: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?

21.web: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
21.asv: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, And kept close from the birds of the heavens.

22.web: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
22.asv: Destruction and Death say, We have heard a rumor thereof with our ears.

23.web: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
23.asv: God understandeth the way thereof, And he knoweth the place thereof.

24.web: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
24.asv: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, And seeth under the whole heaven;

25.web: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
25.asv: To make a weight for the wind: Yea, he meteth out the waters by measure.

26.web: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder;
26.asv: When he made a decree for the rain, And a way for the lightning of the thunder;

27.web: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
27.asv: Then did he see it, and declare it; He established it, yea, and searched it out.

28.web: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
28.asv: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; And to depart from evil is understanding.
